visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Toggle instead of if and else
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The handler checks the class by hand and then adds or removes it. Replace the if with one classList.toggle call. It must behave the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
<style>
  .dark { background: black; color: white; }
</style>
<button id="t">Theme</button>
<script>
  document.getElementById('t').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('dark')) {
      document.body.classList.remove('dark');
    } else {
      document.body.classList.add('dark');
    }
  });
</script>

solution.code:
<style>
  .dark { background: black; color: white; }
</style>
<button id="t">Theme</button>
<script>
  document.getElementById('t').addEventListener('click', function () {
    document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
  });
</script>
solution.explanation: toggle does the check and the change in one call. The four lines of if and else did the same work, with more places to make a mistake.

checks.label: One click makes the page dark
A second click makes it light again
